name: Spotify Mini Player Enlarge
description: Makes the bottom now-playing bar taller with larger track info for TV visibility

params.css: footer, [class*='now-playing-bar'], [class*='NowPlayingBar'] { height: 100px !important; min-height: 100px !important; padding: 10px 20px !important; } footer [data-testid='now-playing-widget'] img, [class*='now-playing-bar'] img { width: 72px !important; height: 72px !important; border-radius: 8px !important; } footer [data-testid='context-item-link'], [class*='now-playing-bar'] [data-testid='context-item-link'] { font-size: 18px !important; font-weight: 600 !important; } footer [data-testid='context-item-info-artist'], [class*='now-playing-bar'] [data-testid='context-item-info-artist'] { font-size: 15px !important; } .Root__main-view { margin-bottom: 100px !important; }
